from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from airflow.models.dagrun import DagRun
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

router = APIRouter(prefix="/airflow/dag-runs")

@router.get("/{dag_id}/{run_id}/state")
async def get_dag_run_state(
    dag_id: str,
    run_id: str,
    session: Session = Depends(get_airflow_session),
    perm_checker: DagPermissionChecker = Depends(get_dag_perm_checker),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if not perm_checker.can_read_dag(dag_id, current_user.tenant_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: Access to DAG run denied")

    dag_run = session.query(DagRun).filter(
        DagRun.dag_id == dag_id,
        DagRun.run_id == run_id
    ).first()

    if not dag_run:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="DAG run not found")

    return {
        "dag_id": dag_id,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "state": dag_run.state,
        "start_date": dag_run.start_date.isoformat() if dag_run.start_date else None,
        "end_date": dag_run.end_date.isoformat() if dag_run.end_date else None
    }
